directive.quote: Complete the authorized request through proportionate checks and a real outcome.

job: prepare source-bound writing classifier adapter training and scoring files from exact private records
preserve: original trainer, scorer, model identity, Records/Files and run-journal owners remain the implementations
gold labels stay outside state; source families and exact byte identities are checked before training
evaluation mode is explicit and no data role can turn evaluation sources into training sources
banned_substitutions: a second model downloader, model cache, Files store, upload runtime or job journal
invented labels, relabelled held-out sources or a private host path treated as durable model authority

distinct_from.why: The original trainer, scorer and provenance tests use local path inputs. Their actual byte-copy ports remain the Python implementation this wrapper invokes; they do not read exact account records or immutable Files inputs, or publish output manifests through the generic engine.

Existing maintained Python training/scoring and exposure code is called, not rebuilt; existing requestPlan owns the request projection. The wrapper adds exact record and file input/output composition within this same capability.

Its existing model_folder and identity_of_files own model resolution and ready-file identity. The trainer invokes those exact functions; it adds no classifier cache, model downloader, inference or bulk-job lifecycle.
The wrapper imports the existing exact-record and whole-file readers, and the generic runner. It defines no alternate Records or Files protocol.
The existing run journal, cancellation and output persistence stay in the engine. This wrapper declares them as DATA and contains no second job store or retry runtime.
Documents the existing local trainer and scorer and their source-bound fixtures; it contains no Records/Files input or adapter output composition.
Synthetic source/provenance fixtures and tests exercise the existing training/scoring contracts. They are retained and extended; they are no implementation of the Records/Files composition.

phrasings: prepare source-bound writing classifier adapter training and scoring files from exact private records
capability_rows: train and evaluate a book's writing-voice classifier
write a short line and a bounded record for every failing test so the saved build keeps the source and assertion that failed

transcribe recordings with a time for every word, and redo the places where the speech model looped; hear a recording in the person's files, or a link's video, into words on their own computer; read transcript and caption files (srt, vtt, txt, json, YouTube json3) into timed words and check quotes against them
record for a short bounded time what the person does on their Mac and give it back as a draft workflow in words
report source files that break a rule written down as DATA
give the page its shipped guided tours when the workspace is built, read from the file the build writes
commit exactly the named files onto main from the shared checkout through a private index
read the exact identity and bytes of local files so a caller can check them against a known hash
stop a build when code reaches into a part's private files or names something a file no longer exports
list the tools an AI can call: derive tool rows from OpenAPI and tool-server sources, sign in to and talk to a tool server, and prepare each tool's result with its declared effects
